title: Advanced Data Network Security and Privacy
description: Computer network security and privacy studied through network traffic analysis, passive and active measurement techniques, protocol analysis, and big data analytics. Covers defensive and offensive traffic analysis techniques within the Internet and Internet protocols.

title: Privacy and Security in Modern Computing
description: Anonymity and re-identification, network privacy, differential privacy algorithms, privacy-preserving machine learning and AI, cryptographic protocols, fairness and ethics, privacy practices

title: Fundamentals of Digital Security and Privacy
description: Provides a comprehensive overview of cybersecurity and privacy terminology, concepts, requirements, policies, and mechanisms. Explores information threats, vulnerabilities, risks and technical approaches to establish confidentiality, integrity, authenticity, availability and non-repudiation of information. Illustrates fundamental concepts as applied to computer systems and networks through hands-on exercises.
notes: Not open to students with credit in CS 574

title: Software Security
description: Hands-on introduction to software security and binary exploitation: from Linux and system-level program behavior to buffer overflows, control-flow hijacking, exploit development, and practical defenses.

title: Wireless Security
description: Wireless data network security and privacy studied through analysis of cryptographic mechanisms that meet the challenges and functional requirements of wireless and mobile environments.

title: Blockchain and Decentralized Cybersecurity
description: Fundamentals of cryptography and its applications on the blockchain technology and cryptocurrency. Topics include hash functions, public key cryptography, digital signatures, blockchain ledger, consensus protocols, smart contracts, decentralized applications, decentralized finance, and state-of-the-art security problems.

title: AI in Cybersecurity
description: Explores the intersection of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Cybersecurity. Applications of AI to detect, defend against, and respond to cybersecurity and privacy threats.

title: Data Privacy
description: Reconstruction attacks, anonymization, differential privacy fundamentals, adversarial and inference attacks, secure learning via DP-SGD and federated training, applications in healthcare, policy, and the data economy.

title: Applied Cybersecurity Management
description: Theory and application of information and information systems defense techniques. Methodologies for attacking and protecting systems and data. Hands-on assignments to include data confidentiality, systems hardening, authentication federation, firewalls, network monitoring and defense, cloud security, penetration testing, and forensic investigation.
